stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Island Biogeography research task. Analyzed species-area relationship using power law model (S = 10.485 × A^0.254, R² = 0.276). Generated comprehensive conservation analysis including habitat loss scenarios, SLOSS analysis, priority island identification, and area requirements. Produced full research report with methodology, results, discussion, and conservation recommendations. All deliverables created: code scripts, output files, visualizations, and publication-quality report.
